scope: Recorded plan snapshots, including post-completion observations. Wait identities use source/context/epoch/JOIN/active tools and are not validated completion labels. Missing diagnostics are unknown, not zero reclaimable capacity. Diagnostic sums can repeat the same native attempt or victim and are not unique evictions, continuous opportunities, recoverable bytes, oracle savings or speedup.

recorded_shared_waiting_volume.semantics: Only listed multi-reference waiting-candidate checks. Deduplicate node ID/creation within each diagnostic using its maximum recorded size; unknown identity or size keeps that diagnostic's complete volume unknown. No cross-time capacity sum, complete cache census, unique eviction or recoverable-byte claim. FULL references count branch ancestry coverage, not necessarily distinct sessions. Other owners' states were not recorded; a causal wait for one recorded context cannot authorize shared reclamation.
